meta.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

copy.tagline: 系统化排查并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的问题
copy.tagline_en: Systematically diagnose and fix code defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix issues in code

howto.what: 遇到 bug 或测试失败时,Claude 会先查清根本原因再动手修复,不会边猜边改。它会按四步走:读懂错误信息、复现问题、检查最近改动、追查数据源头,然后才提出并验证解决方案。
howto.when: 当你提到 bug、测试失败或意外行为等任何技术问题时触发;尤其适合时间紧迫、已试过多次修复或对问题还不理解的情况。

say.text: 我的测试失败了,先帮我查根因再修。
say.note: Claude 会先进入根因调查阶段。

say.text: 别急着改代码,按系统化调试流程一步步排查。
say.note: 它会依次执行四阶段流程。

say.text: 我试了两次修复都没用,重新分析一下根因。
say.note: 若已尝试多次,它会停下来质疑架构。

howto.what_en: When you hit a bug, Claude investigates root cause before fixing. It follows four phases: read errors, reproduce, check changes, gather evidence, then form a hypothesis and test minimally before implementing a fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you report any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, especially under time pressure, after repeated failed fixes, or when the issue isn't fully understood.

say_en.text: My test failed—please find the root cause before fixing.
Don't rush to code changes; debug systematically step by step.
say_en.note: It runs through the four phases in order.

say_en.text: I already tried two fixes; re-analyze the root cause.
say_en.note: After multiple attempts, it questions the architecture.
